why: The harness plugin's auto-broadcast writes every .md/.sh/.go edit into the repository's shared .claude/sessions/broadcast.md and tells the editing session it did so. On 2026-10-31 the four repositories below held 334-500 entries each, and 31-44 of them were Claude Code memory paths (~/.claude/projects/*/memory/) from other sessions.
worktrees: The 5.16.0 plugin reads the file from the checkout it runs in, so a linked worktree keeps broadcasting until it has its own copy. From 5.16.0-cor.1 the main checkout's file covers its linked worktrees, and paths under ~/.claude/projects/ or outside the project are never broadcast.
applied_by: scripts/apply-auto-broadcast-optout.py, run from setup.sh step 6b (a failure is reported and setup continues)
constraints: repos must be ~/Developer/<name>; file and content are fixed in the applier (a declaration that changes them is refused with rc=2)
